import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List of source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # Read and concatenate all source data
    df_list = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        df_list.append(df)
    combined_df = pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure correct data types
    combined_df['condition'] = combined_df['condition'].astype(int)
    combined_df['click'] = combined_df['click'].astype(float)

    # Aggregate: compute mean click grouped by condition
    target_df = combined_df.groupby('condition', as_index=False)['click'].mean()

    # Save to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
